comparison.objective: Search boxes once each, retrieve buttons, and reclose them; candidate tunes and locks an industrial damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual box restraint, sliding-lid operation, search memory, and item retrieval versus recessed tool engagement, fine collar rotation, and bounded locking torque.
comparison.success_condition: Requires each box opened at most once, sequential closure, correct retrieval, and final reset; candidate requires physical unlock/relock and two safe repeatable impact cycles. Numeric lid and placement tolerances are unstated.
comparison.reason: Search-state management and sliding-container manipulation differ materially from dynamic mechanical adjustment.
